# Child mortality - Country rankings

* indicates monthly or quarterly data series

## Deaths of children under five years of age per 1000 live births, 2024:

 The average for 2024 based on 11 countries was 4 deaths per 1000 births. The highest value was in the USA: 7 deaths per 1000 births and the lowest value was in Japan: 2 deaths per 1000 births. The indicator is available from 1960 to 2024. Below is a chart for all countries where data are available. Measure: deaths per 1000 births; Source: UNICEF
